parameters.content:
## 1 · Receive & validate
Token auth, question length and
optional customer email.

## 2 · Retrieve
The question is embedded and the closest help-center
passages are found with pgvector (cosine, HNSW index).
Nothing relevant → escalate without calling the LLM.

## 3 · Answer with guardrails
The LLM may only use the numbered passages and must cite them.
Not answerable, ungrounded, low confidence or account actions
(refunds, disputes, deletions) → escalate to a human.

## 4 · Store, respond & escalate
Every question is stored with its outcome, sources and
similarity score. Escalations reach #support with the
reason and the closest article.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO execution_log (request_id, project, workflow, status, detail, latency_ms)
VALUES ($1::uuid, '03-support-rag', 'support-ask', 'rejected', $2, $3);

SELECT c.id, d.title, d.source, c.heading, c.content,
       round((1 - (c.embedding <=> $1::vector))::numeric, 4) AS similarity
FROM kb_chunks c
JOIN kb_documents d ON d.id = c.document_id
ORDER BY c.embedding <=> $1::vector
LIMIT $2::int;

INSERT INTO support_questions (request_id, channel, customer_email, question, status, escalation_reason,
                               answer, confidence, top_similarity, sources, llm_model)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, NULLIF($3::text, ''), $4, $5, NULLIF($6::text, ''), $7, NULLIF($8::text, ''),
        NULLIF($9::text, '')::numeric, $10::jsonb, NULLIF($11::text, ''))
RETURNING id;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: $('Support Outcome').first().json.status, request_id: $('Support Outcome').first().json.request_id, ticket_id: Number($json.id), answer: $('Support Outcome').first().json.answer, sources: $('Support Outcome').first().json.sources.map(s => ({ title: s.title, section: s.section, source: s.source })) }) }}
